{{Quote|Death to the Imperial Remnant. Death to the New Republic. Long live the Restored Empire. Long live Palpatine!|[[General/Legends|General]] Vota|<ref name="Crimson Empire III: Empire Lost 2">[[Crimson Empire III: Empire Lost 2|''Crimson Empire III: Empire Lost'' 2]]</ref>}}
'''Bernard Vota''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[General/Legends|general]] who was one of the leaders of the [[Restored Empire]] faction. During the early years of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]], Vota served in the [[Commission for the Preservation of the New Order/Legends|Commission for the Preservation of the New Order]] alongside [[Ennix Devian]]. After Devian went on to become an [[Assassin/Legends|assassin]] for the [[Palpatine/Legends|Emperor]], he recruited Vota to help set up a secret storehouse on the [[Planetoid/Legends|planetoid]] [[RZ7-6113-23]] in the [[Chopani sector/Legends|Chopani sector]]. Over the years, they rerouted and stashed weapons and ships that had been scheduled for decommission or destruction. Devian repaired and maintained them as a failsafe against a potential catastrophe in the Empire.<ref>{{SW|url=news/the-imperial-warlords-despoilers-of-an-empire-part-2|series=The Imperial Warlords: Despoilers of an Empire|text=Part 2|nolive=1}}</ref> After the Battle of Endor, Vota joined Devian's Restored Empire. [[Bulger]] served as his [[Aide/Legends|aide]].
Vota died during a failed [[Battle of Orinda (13 ABY)|invasion of]] [[Orinda/Legends|Orinda]], wishing that he had never aligned himself with Ennix Devian. His last words were "Devian-Devian...Don`t Leave Me!".
